stage: Task 3 — Sequence Comparison and Mutation Detection

reference.description: NC_003977.2 Hepatitis B virus (strain ayw) genome

alignment.failure_recovery: Failed batches are recursively split in half; individual records that still fail are logged as mafft_alignment_failed. Five consecutive singleton failures stop the run.

calling_policy.partial_sequences: Terminal unobserved coverage is not called as deletion.
calling_policy.ambiguous_bases: IUPAC ambiguity symbols are emitted as uncertain, not definitive, calls.
calling_policy.insertions: Between-base coordinate N^N+1; terminal insertions are not called.
calling_policy.deletions: Only alignment gaps within observed reference coverage are called.
calling_policy.orientation: Input orientation is retained; no automatic reverse-complement search.
calling_policy.circular_origin: Linear reference coordinates; origin-spanning alignment is a limitation.
